title: Ensemble Distribution and Uncertainty Feature Store
mission: Convert GEFS/IFS/AI ensemble members into calibrated-ready distributions, clusters, probabilities and disagreement features.
steps: Compute member target-day Tmax from each trajectory.
Detect member clusters/multimodality using fold-independent unsupervised algorithms fitted within training periods.
Create control-minus-mean, deterministic-minus-ensemble and cross-ensemble disagreement.
Retain member completeness and model-change flags.
acceptance: GEFS distribution features complete on core frame
failure: Insufficient members: set distribution unavailable; do not fake with interpolation
